# Emphasis and Escapes

Plain, *emphasised*, **strong**, ***both at once***, and _underscored_
emphasis; an intraword snake_case_name keeps its underscores.

Escaped characters stay literal: \*not emphasis\*, \# not a heading.

A backslash at the end of a line\
forces a hard break,  
as do two trailing spaces.

Entities and references: &amp; &copy; &#169; &#x00A9; and a lone & sign.
